entry_points.text: Entry diverts external aborts, enforces limits and takes read lock. It resolves nested with retry handled and failures injected, then handles unmapped via instruction, walk, cache or IO, else completes access or dispatches to protected, guest or user before release, trapping out-of-bounds and unexpected kinds.
Reservation copies host regions, sums table and metadata needs, allocates contiguous region with fallback, records base and size. Table init binds MMU, empties cache, ignores allocators and succeeds.
Discovery skips without usable PMU on all CPUs, else appends under mutex. Event programming masks with VM mask, assigns and recreates backing.

exports.text: Install tracks ranges and needs exclusive MMU asserted; protected allows single-page full-access with contention report, others allow blocks, replace overlaps and share via hypervisor. Mode flag, memblock view, base and size are global.

SEA goes to firmware then injects or exits. Nested checks exec or read-write and injects on violation. Extent uses tag, shadow hint or granule max with no largest width. Iterate matches VMID and S1 handling discards VNCR by scope under write; full flush releases shadows.

Range unmap and young ops are no-ops without tables or when protected with deferred young; unmap clears shadow. Commit write-protects and splits for logging; prepare validates bounds, flags, private, tagging and direct maps; free, update and write-held flush finish.

hazards.text: Unlinked alloc, free and split warn and fail and must never be used. Full teardown warns on active refs yet releases tables.

Protected uses single-page full access; others allow blocks with cacheability from attributes and warn on overlaps. Error exit preserves syndrome fields plus tag bits, with physical validity and omitted virtual when invalid.
Hazards are write plus exec, missing VMA, bad size, poison, unsuitable file pages for protected pin, cacheable direct without hardware, exec on uncached and unsupported codes.

invariants.text: VMA capture under read records size, frame, tags and seq. Size steps down unless huge, clamps to nested. Pin faults frame, flags poison and device. Prot adds write and exec then intersects nested. Sample seq before lock, abandon on race, relax or install and dirty. User provisions memcache; guest resolves from nested or address.

Protected abort pins one page under exclusive, installs full-access and unwinds on failure. Revocation walks half-open range safely and frees trackers. Teardown starts dying once, reclaims per page for protected or unshares otherwise; final destroy expects empty. Forced reclaim treats contention as progress.

Access faults trace and mark young via shared walks. Host owns SEA without RAS, on hyp data abort outside nested, or stage-two table walk. Hyp layer allocates zeroed pages and delegates refcount and conversion.

Syndrome keeps ESR except status. Granule from control. Hint under write aligns, consults shadow, returns tag on coverage. VNCR inval under write bumps seq then discards by scope. S1 decode groups families. VNCR perm promotes RO write else injects with guest level.

ID sanitizer clears unsupported, forces 64-bit, clamps enums, picks personality. Field keeps minimum. Event mask from exclusions and levels. Chain allows even below cycle. Accessible clears hyp-reserved below EL2. Writes release backing, preserve upper unless forced, recreate; userspace defers reload.
These paths use external bitfield, memslot lookup, frame translation, rwlock, write barrier and atomic helpers owned outside this dossier.

locks.text: Backend denies protected mutation. Unmap needs write-held MMU and unshares; others need held MMU and delegate per tracker or clean caches. PMU list uses global mutex during append.

state_machines.text: First set-way with trapping off flushes and enables trap; toggle flushes on change and clears trap when on. VNCR abort pins epoch, retries or exits for backing, else checks permission. Translation walks and faults under read, validates strictly, publishes under write unless raced, with dirty accounting.
Finalize is one-way from protected uninitialized. It excludes hyp memory from leak checks, enables branch before stage-two, runs per-CPU hypercall and reports failure when privilege drop incomplete.

Counting needs global and per-counter enable, filters type, wraps, sets overflow and chains neighbor. Host overflow stops backing, resets period, requests IRQ, kicks or defers, then restarts. Control clears long-cycle, reloads on toggle and zeroes counters on reset.

structs.text: Fault descriptor carries CPU, address, nested result, slot and host address. VMA info carries seq, sizes, flags, frames and device, tag, cacheable, writable and forced-uncached marks.

VNCR cache holds guest and host addresses, walk data, writable, CPU marker and validity under write lock. Walk carries base, width, shift, level and flags. Scope discriminates full, address and identifier forms. Two per CPU.
Mapping spans frame to frame-plus-count as inclusive bytes. Low config bit selects 64-bit counters. Trap mask combines debug, trace, PMU and lock controls.
